name: skill.open
description: 按目录 ID 读取一项能力的完整说明和相关工具目录；详细参数单独查看，不读取金融资料。

parameters.skill_id: 主 Prompt 能力目录中的 ID，不接受路径

name: tool.describe
description: 按名称查看一个本轮可用工具的完整参数契约，不执行该工具也不增加权限。

parameters.name: 本轮工具目录中的完整名称

name: article.list
description: 按作者文件夹和日期浏览本地文章元数据，不读取正文。

name: article.read
description: 读取 article.list 返回的一篇文章的限定行，读取后才能归因作者观点。

name: article.claims
description: 按需提炼并保存带来源定位的文章观点；输出是作者观点，不是已验证事实。

name: article.study
description: Optionally study one selected article with a separate model call. Deep reads its full text in bounded sections; skim reads only chosen lines. Returns source-bound claims and a saved card ID, not verified market facts.

parameters.question: Question to apply to this article
parameters.start_line: Required for skim: first source line

name: source.discover
description: 发现免费公开网页线索；标题和摘要只是线索，不能代替正文证据。

name: source.fetch
description: 读取允许的公开官方 HTML/文本正文；不支持 PDF，需寻找可访问版或披露缺口。读取本身不等于结论已被核实。

name: web.search
description: 搜索免费公开网页，返回发现线索，不写入证据账本。

name: web.open
description: 读取公开 HTML/文本网页的限定正文和元数据，并形成网页证据；长网页返回 next_start_line，可再次调用读取后续行；PDF 不支持。

parameters.url: 搜索结果或用户提供的公开 HTTP(S) URL
parameters.start_line: 可选，起始正文行号，默认 1；长网页用上次的 next_start_line 继续

name: market.catalog
description: 列出支持的行情品种、单位和口径。

name: market.snapshot
description: 获取指定品种和时间范围的公开日线数据，不负责分析。核查历史日期时显式传 start/end 和 latest_completed=false；省略日期只取得最近完成交易日。

parameters.latest_completed: 是否取最近完成交易日

name: market.metrics
description: 对已获取的行情快照计算确定性变化指标。

name: market.series
description: 展开已获取快照中的单一品种日线。

name: research.plan
description: 每轮取材前创建简洁但完整的研究计划，之后可查看或更新目标与结构化范围；简单问题也需规划，但不预设取材、分析或委派方式。scope 只记录用户范围，不规定后续工作流。

parameters.goals: create 时必须是 2-8 项字符串数组，例如 ["定位问题", "完成证据核对"]
parameters.scope: 可选对象；authors 必须是作者名数组，date_range 必须是对象。示例：{"authors":["TT","培风客"],"date_range":{"start":"2026-10-01","end":"2026-10-31"},"topics":["黄金"],"deliverable":"回答用户问题并披露缺口"}
parameters.goal_id: update 时的整数目标编号
parameters.status: update 时为 pending | done | blocked
parameters.run_id: load 时同一会话内的来源运行 ID

name: research.artifact
description: Save/list/reload immutable current-run research by generated ID, never paths. Omitted version retains legacy cards. Explicit v2 stores coherent understanding/synthesis/working views with Runtime-bound source and input scope; a stored result is not verified or published. get returns the full validated record; v2 list is paginated and stale cursors must be restarted.

parameters.schema_version: Optional finance.research_artifact.v1 (legacy default) | finance.research_artifact.v2 (explicit research save/list)
parameters.kind: v1: article_card | comparison | review | research_note; v2: article_understanding | synthesis | working_view
parameters.research_task: Required for v2 save: finance.research_task.v1 with original_query, objective, material_refs, requested_result_kind, completion_expectation, optional reading_request/focus/user_requirements; details in versioned_research skill
parameters.payload: v2 save: finance.research_result.v1 {schema_version, content, evidence_links, material_disposition, gaps, limitations, optional supporting_artifact_refs/candidate_answer}; legacy payload unchanged
parameters.artifact_id: get: a generated current-run v1/v2 ID
parameters.cursor: v2 list only: opaque next_cursor; omit for first page

name: research.disposition
description: Record the main Agent's decision on a returned research result before delivery. This is not a verification certificate and does not force use of every read source.

parameters.result_ref: artifact_id or result_checksum in a current-run validated ingestion receipt
parameters.reason: Nonblank reason addressing the current question

name: research.synthesize
description: Optionally compare 2-20 independently studied article cards around one question. A separate model pass proposes agreement, disagreement, evolution or complementary views, with claim IDs validated against distinct sources. Returns a saved comparison ID or an explicit no-relation result.

parameters.question: Exact comparison question
parameters.card_ids: 2-20 card_* IDs from article.study or research.artifact

name: research.verify
description: Optional typed model review of selected article-card claims against already observed evidence. Distinguishes faithful author attribution, fact support/refutation, future forecasts, causal hypotheses and model inference; returns a review ID, revision suggestions and precise missing-evidence queries. It does not itself browse or certify independent source acquisition.

parameters.claim_ids: Optional 1-30 claim_* IDs from those cards
parameters.evidence_ids: Optional canonical IDs of public/market evidence read this turn

name: research.checkpoint
description: Record the main Agent's verification decision after analysis. This records checks, observed EvidenceRefs and gaps; it does not verify claims by itself or require any particular research tool.

parameters.checks: 1-20 objects: claim, decision (check|not_needed), outcome (supported|refuted|inconclusive|not_applicable|not_due), method, evidence_refs, reason, gap; not_due is for forecasts whose horizon has not ended

name: research.coverage
description: Record why article evidence is sufficient to synthesize or which specific question gap justifies more reading. This is the main Agent's judgment, not a fixed article-count threshold or external verification.

parameters.aspects: 1-12 objects: question, status (covered|partial|uncovered), evidence_refs, contrary_evidence_refs, gap
parameters.reason: Why to continue or stop acquiring evidence
parameters.next_need: Required for continue: specific missing information
parameters.sample_scope: Authors, dates and limits of the actually read sample

name: context.open
description: Restore a run-local offloaded observation. Small records are exact objects; large records return continuous original JSON-text pages, never summaries or new evidence. Follow next_offset for additional pages, or save a working view after analysis rather than repeatedly restoring the same page.

parameters.context_id: Generated context_* ID from an offloaded_observation marker
parameters.offset: Optional character offset; use next_offset from the previous page
parameters.limit: Optional maximum characters, 1-12000; Runtime may reduce the page to fit input budget

name: memory_search
description: Search this workspace's persisted user memory and preferences. It is context, not external market evidence.

name: company_wiki_search
description: 搜索当前工作空间的用户背景、研究偏好和 Wiki 事实。

name: finance.report_read
description: 按需展开当前会话已授权的历史金融快照；只读，不联网。

parameters.document_id: 原文展开时的文档 ID
